Secondly, gold is seen as a safe-haven asset, drawing investors during times of economic uncertainty. In recent years, gold has proven resilient, exhibiting minimal losses even during periods of sharp market downturns. Therefore, in light of these compelling arguments, I believe gold's 25% allocation ratio provides a suitable hedge against inflationary pressures.
